units.source_text: 天色将暮，乐人奏出《皇麞》之曲，音节非常美丽。

en.t: As dusk was falling, the musicians began to play the piece Huangzhang, and its rhythm was exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 大家舍不得离船，然而游船已经驶近钓殿，只得舍舟登陆。

en.t: Everyone was reluctant to leave the boat, but the pleasure boat had already drawn near the fishing pavilion, so they had no choice but to go ashore.

units.source_text: 钓殿的装饰甚是朴素，却富有优雅之趣。

en.t: The fishing pavilion was decorated very simply, yet it had a richly elegant charm.

units.source_text: 紫姬身边的许多青年侍女在此等候。

en.t: Many young attendants who served Lady Murasaki were waiting there.

units.source_text: 她们竞夸新装，个个打扮得齐齐整整，望去只见花团锦簇。

en.t: They vied with one another in showing off their new attire, each dressed neatly and beautifully, so that from a distance they looked like a mass of brocade flowers.

units.source_text: 此时乐人奏出世间难得听到的名曲。

en.t: At this moment, the musicians performed famous pieces rarely heard in the world.

units.source_text: 选用的舞人也都是特别优秀的能手。

en.t: The dancers chosen for the occasion were all exceptionally accomplished performers as well.

units.source_text: 他们尽力献技，以博紫夫人的欢心。

en.t: They displayed their skills with all their might in hopes of pleasing Lady Murasaki.
